serpAudit.intent: Informational and current-status: readers need to know whether the Friday WFH policy still applies, which Mendagri circular is current, what the June adjustment changed, and how local implementation affects staff.
contentGap: many high-ranking search results still describe the March circular as current
few concise explanations connect the June 1 replacement circular with the continuing Friday WFH pattern in the official socialization material
explain local discretion and service continuity without treating one region’s schedule as a national rule
serpAudit.competitionAssessment: The broad WFH ASN term has substantial news competition. The long-tail opportunity is current status and the specific 000.9.6.1/4412/SJ circular; search results sampled show older March coverage alongside a smaller number of June-status resources. No validated volume or formal difficulty score is available.

limitations: Implementation schedules and WFH/WFO proportions can be set through local technical arrangements; do not present one locality’s roster as nationwide.
The exact central circular PDF is linked from the Ministry of Home Affairs PPID; status and repeal metadata were cross-checked in JDIH OKI.
SERP assessment is a manual sample; no search volume or keyword difficulty is claimed.
